D. Parents accompany their children to write homework, which will make the children lack independence and initiative in learning. All day long, under the dual pressure of teachers and parents, it is difficult to develop interest in learning and to develop an independent personality.

text: D. Parents accompany their children to write homework, which will make the children lack independence and initiative in learning.

The third group was fed a high-fat diet but added a "tea saponin" extracted from the tea. From this, the researchers have concluded that the "natural product" of tea saponin has the ability to inhibit lipases. People Drinking tea does produce weight loss.

D. The differences between mice and humans are still very large, and the conclusions of the mouse experiments have only a certain reference for humans.

The culture of any country is national and cosmopolitan, but in the development process, the emphasis may be different, and the consequences are different: too much emphasis on the nationality of culture may disassociate national culture from world culture. In addition, if too much emphasis is placed on the cosmopolitan nature of culture, national culture may lose its national characteristics. From the actual situation of cultural development, in order to establish the status of each country's culture on the world stage, it must highlight the nationality of culture. A culture that has lost its national identity cannot have much influence. However, not any adherence to a nationality will lead to cosmopolitanism. A culture can only have its vitality and vitality if it reflects the pulse of the times, reflects the spirit of the times, and responds to the voice of the times. Will have a worldwide impact.

Final answer: A
